summary: Roll7's arena-action game combining roller-skating flow, trick-chaining, and third-person shooting in a cel-shaded dystopian bloodsport.

entries.title: Rollerdrome

emulation.notes: Run natively on Windows at the highest stable settings.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC release at highest stable settings

primary.why: Rollerdrome released for Windows, PlayStation 4, and PlayStation 5 in August 2022, then Xbox Series X/S in November 2023. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible route for Roll7's roller-skating shooter, though storefront availability changed after Private Division/Roll7 corporate changes.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version at the highest stable settings if owned/available; use PS5 or Xbox Series X/S as strong console alternatives.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster; publishing rights moved to 2K after Private Division/Roll7 corporate changes, so storefront availability should be rechecked when buying.
